review.notes:
Tests-only LAS 2.0.5 regrade of the unchanged preserved gpt-5.6-luna Max Python source. The previous 2.0.4 publication scored 216/223; the corrected suite scores 220/223 with no skips or errors. All 219 unaffected node identities and outcomes are identical, and the four renamed zero-waveform cases pass. Their fixtures now retain valid file-level descriptors and storage, changing only the point's waveform association. Descriptor index zero is a per-point absence marker and does not unambiguously waive separately required file metadata. Any previous classification of metadata/storage-free zero-waveform rejection as a proven model defect is withdrawn. The old publication and prior audit chain are preserved in full. Unchanged observed failure families: internal waveform packet interval validation, Extra Bytes float-triplet overflow handling. Exact failed nodes: test_validation.py::test_inspect_rejects_waveform_packet_outside_payload[2-4]; test_validation.py::test_render_rejects_waveform_packet_outside_payload[2-4]; test_validation.py::test_render_rejects_extra_bytes_float_triplet_overflow. Repeated format/action observations are not counts of independent implementation bugs. The original completion, source/transcript and accounting reviews remain applicable to the unchanged generation; their full historical editorial text remains in the linked prior publication. Root and an independent reviewer checked the revised public-contract interpretation, focused reference/mutation controls, source preservation and per-case comparison.  Original raw result/source hashes, generation metadata, input/output/cache/reasoning token totals and recorded cost are retained. Current usage is independently reparsed from preserved events. The regrade makes no new model calls and adds no generation cost. Reasoning remains an output subset. Any separate tool-count recovery is explicitly linked and preserves its historical evidence.

Run conditions: apps available but no external tool invocation observed.

Tool calls corrected from 66 to 67: proven rejected requests omitted from canonical items. Token totals, reasoning counts and generation cost are unchanged; original usage and session hashes are preserved in the regrade audit.

editorial.last_message: Completed the Python LAS implementation; unchanged source passes 216/223 under LAS 2.0.4. Remaining gaps: absent-waveform validation, waveform interval checks, Extra Bytes overflow handling.
editorial.notes:
Completed the Python inspector/renderer voluntarily; the retained transcript and source show a substantial implementation with the specific remaining validation failures listed below. The LAS 2.0.4 result remains 216/223, matching the prior 2.0.3 score. The original generation grade was 213/219 under LAS 2.0.1. This official zero-inference regrade uses the committed 2.0.4 suite and the pinned offline Docker image. Its complete 223-node outcome mapping matches the independently validated scratch report. All 222 unchanged node outcomes match the 2.0.3 baseline; only the renamed negative is semantically replaced. The new negative declares external waveform storage while retaining internal packet data and keeps the internal bit clear; it does not duplicate the both-bits-set check. Acceptance/rejection solely for a clear deprecated internal bit remains unscored.  Remaining source defects: A waveform descriptor/storage mode is required from the point format before recognizing descriptor index 0 as no associated waveform. This one implementation defect is observed in formats 4, 5, 9 and 10. Inspect/render accept packet offsets overlapping the 60-byte EVLR header. Upper payload bounds are checked; the lower bound is missing. An unused Extra Bytes floating-triplet slot containing a huge integer causes an unhandled conversion in zero_float and exit 2/internal_error, instead of deliberate invalid-request rejection. Full original transcript/source reviews are carried forward with their reviewer, content hash and path below. Those earlier reviews are historical evidence; their former tool-count exactness claims are superseded by the current session-based audit. Audited v2 tool calls: 67; preserved original recorded count: 66. The difference is a proven attempted tool request rejected before any canonical item; this does not change the counting definition. Input, output, cache and reasoning totals reparse exactly and remain complete; all token/cost fields and generation metadata are preserved. Regrading adds no model calls or generation cost. Original result/source/session/raw reports and previous regrade history remain unchanged. Run conditions: apps available but no external tool invocation observed.

Tool calls corrected from 66 to 67: proven rejected requests omitted from canonical items. Token totals, reasoning counts and generation cost are unchanged; original usage and session hashes are preserved in the regrade audit.
